description: Landscape Architecture is the design of outdoor places: visiting a designed landscape, analyzing how it works for people, choosing plants for your region, measuring and redesigning a real entry area, and careers in the field.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Visiting a landscape
requirements.summary: Visiting a completed landscape designed by a landscape architect.

requirements.title: Analyzing the design
requirements.summary: How the site’s spaces, structures, plants and seating serve the people who use it.

requirements.title: Choosing plants
requirements.summary: Shrubs, trees and a ground cover that suit your area and how you would use them.

requirements.title: A redesign
requirements.summary: Measuring and drawing a building entry to scale and redesigning it to be safer and more comfortable.

requirements.title: Careers
requirements.summary: Landscape architecture careers and researching one of them.
